raised: The page never says what the current account actually costs in shekels; the cost table only says it depends on the bank's price list
No real interest rates are given, so nothing can be compared
The coloured-number key ('מקמר / חושב / הזנתם') and the word 'מקמר' are confusing
The basic vs. extended fee package sentence is unclear, including what each costs
The calculator uses a 5% return although the current account pays nothing or almost nothing
Unclear whether figures are 'בכסף של היום' or 'בשקלים של העתיד'
Nothing suggests entering 0% to see what really happens to money left in the account
The BANK-20/BANK-23/BANK-15 tags mean nothing to the reader
Parts of the 'כסף נכנס ויוצא' section and other blocks were cut off between screenshots
The dark red 'שאלה פתוחה: TXI OQ11' strip looks like a warning but is unclear
Worried that Israel has no deposit insurance and the 250,000 ₪ protection is only a proposal
The 'מה האתר לקח בחשבון' section reads like internal notes (padlocks, 'חסום'); would drop it
The terms table appears twice
Chart colours (green area, pink line, pale line) are unlabelled
The 62,681 'your deposits' figure doesn't match the reader's count of 70,000
The 'חוקים וכללים' column in the cost table is empty
Unclear whether the 'מזומן שקלי' chip is clickable or just a label
Couldn't find how much is lost each year by leaving money at 0% while prices rise
Couldn't find how much to keep in the current account for everyday needs
Couldn't find whether a money market fund is protected if the fund company or bank fails
Couldn't find what to say to the bank when asking
Would drop the 'כסף נכנס ויוצא' cards about moving shares
The BANK OQ9 code is not understood

problems.why: The reader asks why the calculator and chart show a 5% return for an account that usually pays nothing, which is a clear part of the person's complaint that the interest example and chart don't fit most people's idle money, which earns nothing.
